description:
Three small one-liner-ish fixes bundled:

a) `loop.ex:137` — `stream_turn` reduces AI events with nil seed.
   If the transport never emits Done/Error, the accumulator stays
   nil and we append nil to messages. Fix: if acc is nil at the
   end, synthesize an "unexpected end of stream" error assistant.

b) `session.ex:158` — `Process.exit(loop_task, :kill)` on the
   second call of a double-abort hits a dead pid. Harmless but
   noisy. Guard with `Process.alive?/1` (or check `loop_task != nil`
   which already happens; tighten to live-only).

c) `loop.ex:82` — `Session.drain_steering(session)` runs on every
   loop iteration including turn 1 (empty queue, harmless but an
   unnecessary GenServer round-trip). Skip on first turn.

TDD:
- Test: FakeTransport script with no Done/Error → run completes
  with synthesized error, not a nil-bearing transcript.
- Existing cancellation tests cover (b) once guard is added; add a
  new test that calls abort twice rapidly and asserts no crash.
- (c) is pure perf, covered by existing tests (should still pass).
title: Small defensive hardening: nil stream, dead-pid guard, skip drain turn 1
